column1: # Papers and citation labels: (source, id regex) or (source, DOI) -> DOI and journal reference. Citations only:
# DOIs and journal references, never author names or text from papers. A row with an id_pattern applies to the
# records of its source whose id matches; a row without one applies to the records of its source whose own
# citation carries its DOI. The first matching row wins, and a matching record that cites another DOI stops the run.
# With a reference, the citation label becomes '<reference>, <doi>' and the input stays in citation_original.
# The npr input cites two papers (literature README section 1); npr-a and npr-b are one paper.
# The rows with a reference are provisional WS0 fixes of 2026-11-19 (Stop A handback, section 6.1 'upstream'),
# each checked against candidates-20261118/records.tsv: the record citations name a wrong author, no author or an
